source.rationale: Delta-4: a date/code suggestion AND a CS roster in the same turn are shown TOGETHER, and this arm rebuilds the picker itself — so it must carry the same company labels and the same cs_multi_note build-cs-member-offer wrote, or a two-company roster reaches the customer as a bare list of names. A company that was QUERIED but returned no members (present in routing_companies, absent from the rows) is disclosed with the omitted-line rather than silently vanishing. selection_context is 'member_offer' (a number picks a person, not a code) while the quick replies still come from the suggestion.
source.repin_rationale: RE-PINNED at live df165492 (media-intake promote). Two changes, both re-derived from the new contract: (1) a final em-dash sanitizer deep-walks the returned payload, so every U+2014 in user_response / variables.* folds to a plain hyphen; (2) miss/DYM lines now carry an entity-type suffix ` (<type>)` on the quoted token - resolver PRIMARY (that token's resolution matches[0].entity_type, prettified only when snake_case/kebab), parser `hint` FALLBACK, bare when neither classifies. The new MI-D media-confirm prefix is inert on these fixtures (patch-transcript not executed). Numbering, dym_last_result_set and dym candidates are unchanged.
